message: All required sources are available. EKOS can generate a decision packet.
summary: Projected SAP-like assets plus curated supplemental carrier and governance sources complete the minimum source package.

aliases.why_it_matters: Identifies the primary delivery object and current logistics status.
Provides delivery event context for the delay.
Defines confirmation requirements before workflow preparation.
Determines whether external carrier confirmation is current, stale, missing, or trustworthy.
Defines who may prepare, review, approve, or block the requested business action.

warnings: Delivery and tracking records remain projected from local SAP-like assets.
This is controlled onboarding, not live SAP integration.
Decision packet generation still does not mean approval.
